FTV Skincare – Luxury, Australian-Made Skincare with a Global Vision

Brand Introduction

FTV Skincare is the official skincare brand of FashionTV, combining beauty, innovation, and science to create premium skincare solutions. Proudly Australian-made, our products are crafted with high-performance ingredients to deliver visible, long-lasting results. We are committed to clean beauty, ensuring our formulations are cruelty-free, ethically sourced, and suitable for all skin types.

Product Description

Our skincare range includes serums, cleansers, moisturizers, body mists, and specialty treatments infused with cutting-edge ingredients like Osmo'city™, GENENCARE® OSMS, and botanical extracts. Designed to hydrate, protect, and revitalize, our products cater to beauty enthusiasts who seek luxury and efficacy in their daily skincare routine.

Unique Selling Points

  • Official FashionTV Skincare Brand – Backed by a globally recognized beauty and fashion network.
  • Australian-Made – Formulated and manufactured in Australia with high-quality ingredients.
  • Innovative Active Ingredients – Featuring Osmo'city™, GENENCARE® OSMS, and plant-based actives for superior skincare benefits.
  • Clean & Ethical – Cruelty-free, no harsh chemicals, and suitable for all skin types.
  • Global Appeal – Luxury skincare designed for beauty lovers worldwide.

Affiliate Program Details

  • Commission Rate: Competitive commission on every successful sale.
  • Cookie Duration: Generous 90 days cookie tracking to maximize your earnings.
  • Payment Terms: Monthly payouts via PayPal or bank transfer.
  • Marketing Support: Access to banners, product images, and exclusive promo codes.
  • Dedicated Affiliate Manager: Personalized support to help you succeed.

Join Us Today!

Partner with FTV Skincare and earn commissions while promoting a luxurious, Australian-made skincare brand. Apply now and start earning!
